Hi Peter -

Maybe I'm biased by being a student there, but for what it's worth I
took a full course on statistical graphics with Hadley at Rice and it
was excellent. Literally everyday I learned not only new ggplot stuff
but also general tricks in R, the kind of stuff that you see and
you're like wow, I wish I had known that when I was doing x. So I
would highly recommend his teaching.

My experience previous to his course was 5 or so years with R as well
as teaching summer sessions for our statistics REU students (RUSIS).

hope it helps
david.
